agent._resumeNotice: Verified against Pi's official README: 'pi -c                  # Continue most recent session'. https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/README.md. --session requires a path or id.
agent._resumeStyleNotice: Diri pins Pi's fresh and continue commands to a per-session provider directory, so `-c` cannot accidentally select another Diri session's latest conversation.
